issues.where: SCOPE (d) last paragraph (l.262-275), REPORT theo:local_virt_tame findings[7] and sorries[0] ('the construction goes through wherever the loops of reg V̂ local at s are generated by meridians of strata of finite local degree'), kb_proposals last item
issues.problem: This informal generalisation overreaches. (A)+(C) give that a T_α-open O ∋ ŝ has open image, so for each point t of a finite-degree stratum near s, O contains SOME lift of t, and hence meridians around the lifted sheets O meets. The paper's (D) needs this for every O: π₁(reg O) must surject onto K = π₁(reg V̂). When the local group is non-abelian and the stratum has several lifted sheets through ŝ, K may need the meridians around the other sheets (conjugates of b), which O need not contain. The WP-35f two-planes case is abelian (Hopf link, ℤ²), so the refutation of THAT candidate stands. But the recorded 'shape any counterexample must have' (a loop NOT generated by finite-degree meridians) may be too narrow.
issues.fix: Restrict the generalisation to the case actually argued: the local group is abelian, or the meridians O is forced to contain generate K. Or add the sheet/conjugation caveat to the counterexample shape. The Lean statements are unaffected.
